d: A country mansion full of guests soon becomes the playground of a killer after a hidden stash of embezzled money.  The guests begin to disappear one by one as The Bat's identity is closer to being discovered.
Dr. Paul Carruthers is cheated by his employers after developing a new aftershave lotion, so he seeks revenge by using a giant killer bat to kill anyone wearing the lotion.

Otte måneder efter at en ukendt morder har skåret hovedet af en turist, ankommer den unge Jennifer Corvino til Schweiz for at blive indskrevet på sin nye privatskole. Efter at Jennifer har gået i søvne, overværet et nyt mord og faret vild i skoven.

t: The Return of the Living Dead
d: Two employees of a medical supply company accidentally release a toxic gas that raises up the dead.  Soon the town is overrun with flesh-eating residents of the local cemetery who are hungry for human brains.

In this classic adaptation of H.G. Wells' novel, a demented doctor (Burt Lancaster) spends years on a desolate tropical island working on a drug that will effectively alter animals into humans. Michael York and Barbara Carrera also star!
Robert Mitchum stars in an unforgettable role as a psychopathic preacher in relentless pursuit of two children who have their dead father's stolen fortune hidden in a doll.  Shelley Winters co-stars.

A fanatical Egyptologist purchases a stolen jewel, believing in its power to restore the dead.  The stone is pursued by a zealot determined to return it to the tomb from which it was stolen before it can release its worst power.

The sorcerer Craven learns from fellow magician Dr. Bedlo that his supposedly dead wife is alive and living at the castle of master sorcerer Dr. Scarabus. The film is presented without local subtitles.

When an evil troll named Torok attempts to bring about cataclysmic changes that will forever erase mankind, an ancient sorceress and a young boy join forces to stop him before he can carry out his diabolical plan.

A plantation owner desires another man's bride and enlists the help of a witch doctor to use a mind-control potion to make her fall in love with him.  Instead, the witch doctor turns against them both.
